questions.question: ______ is the first woman hockey player to receive the Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Rani Rampal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rani Rampal **is the first woman hockey player to receive the **Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award.**
 
• She was the youngest player in the national team that competed in the 2010 World Cup at the age of 15.
 
• She completed her education but was unable to obtain a graduate degree due to scheduled practice sessions and competitions. On her team, she is a forward.
 
• She has scored **134 goals in 212 international appearances.**
 
• She is the captain of the** Indian Women's Hockey Team** at the moment.
 
• She is also recognised as a striker who frequently plays in the midfield. The Indian government awarded her the Padma Shri in 2020.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• **Vandana Katariya__ **is an Indian field hockey player who represents her country as a forward. Vandana rose to attention after scoring the most goals for India in the Women's Hockey Junior World Cup in 2013.
 
• **__Nikki Pradhan__ **is a professional field hockey player from India who also plays for the national squad. She was the first female athlete from Jharkhand to compete in the Olympics for India.
 
• **__Sharmila Devi__ **is a field hockey player from India. In the 2019 Women's FIH Olympic Qualifiers, she made her international debut against the USA, scoring a goal.

questions.question: The Nobel Peace Prize 2020 was awarded to:
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**World Food Programme.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **UN World Food Programme (WFP), which provides lifesaving food assistance to millions across the world- often in extremely dangerous and hard-to-access conditions- has been awarded the 2020 Nobel Peace Prize.**
 
• The agency was recognized "for its efforts to combat hunger, for its contribution to bettering conditions for peace in conflict-affected areas and for acting as a driving force to prevent the use of hunger as a weapon of war and conflict.
 
• **WFP is the largest humanitarian organization in the world. Last year, it assisted 97 million people in 88 countries.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• **Nobel Peace Prize:**

 
 
• It is one of the five Nobel prizes established by the will of Swedish industrialist, inventor and armaments manufacturer Alfred Nobel, along with the prizes in Chemistry, Physics, Physiology or Medicine and Literature.
 
• It was established in 1895 and First awarded in 1901.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **International Monetary Fund:**

 
 
• It works to achieve sustainable growth and prosperity for all of its 190 member countries.
 
• It does so by supporting economic policies that promote financial stability and monetary cooperation, which are essential to increase productivity, job creation, and economic well-being.
 
 
 
• **Amnesty International:**
 
 
• It is an international non-governmental organization focused on human rights, with its headquarters in the United Kingdom.
 
 
 
• **World Health Organization:**
 
 
• It is a specialized agency of the United Nations, established in 1948.
 
• The constitution of WHO was signed by 61 countries in 1946.

questions.question: Who among the following won the Global Gandhi Peace Award in October 2020?
questions.solution:

• The award carries an amount of Rs. 1 crore, a citation, a plaque and an exquisite traditional handicraft or handloom item.
 
• The award is not just given to individuals but also to associations, institutions or organizations.

questions.question: Who among the following was the first musician ever to be awarded the Bharat Ratna, India's highest civilian honour?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__MS Subbulakshmi__. **

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **MS Subbulakshmi** was the **first musician** ever to be awarded the **Bharat Ratna, India's highest civilian honour**.
 
• MS Subbulakshmi was awarded by **Bharat ratna** in **1998.**
 
• MS Subbulakshmi was an Indian Carnatic singer from** Madurai, Tamil Nadu**.
 
• She has recorded songs in over a thousand Hindi films and has sung songs in almost all Indian regional languages and foreign languages, though primarily in Marathi, Hindi, and Bengali.
 
• **France** conferred her its highest civilian award **(Officer of the Legion of Honour**) in 2007.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• ​The **Bharat Ratna** is the highest civilian award of the Republic of India.

 
 
• Established: 2 January 1954
 
• First awarded: 1954: C. Rajagopalachari; Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan; C. V. Raman
 
• Total: 48
 
• **Awarded**: 2019: Nanaji Deshmukh (Posthumous), Bhupen Hazarika (Posthumous); Pranab Mukherjee.
 
 
 
• 2024 Awardee : They are Karpoori Thakur, Mankombu Sambasivan (MS) Swaminathan, Pamulaparthi Venkata (P. V.) Narasimha Rao, Lal Krishna Advani, and Chaudhary Charan Singh.
